title: Dense transformer baseline
question: What does a plain ~10M-param causal transformer reach on TinyStories at our compute budget? Every later arc is measured against this.

title: Linear-time mixers
question: Can Gated DeltaNet (vs Mamba-2 vs sliding-window only) plus one global attention layer match the baseline, while memory stops growing with context?

title: Looped core block
question: Does one shared core block looped r times match a deeper unshared model with far fewer parameters? Does quality keep improving when r at test time exceeds r in training?

title: Ternary weights
question: How much quality does BitNet b1.58 ternary cost here, and does looping amplify quantization error across loops?

title: Full fusion
question: Linear mixers + loops + ternary together: do they stack, or does the fusion fail? Success here is v1.0.0.

title: Adaptive loops per token
question: Can a learned halting signal spend more loops on hard tokens and fewer on easy ones, at equal quality?

title: Critique → fix inside the recurrence
question: Do per-loop supervision, a grounded critic head, and adversarial damage-and-repair make loops actually fix their own errors?

title: Loops vs chain-of-thought
question: How much written-out reasoning can silent latent loops replace? Same task, looped-no-CoT vs plain-with-CoT, matched compute.

title: Self-speculative decoding
question: Draft with 1–2 loops, verify with full r: what is the acceptance rate, and the real speedup on the laptop?
